```plato
    // The first field with the second carved out of it: a against the negated b.
    // A lower bound.
    Difference(a: ScalarFunctionField2D, b: ScalarFunctionField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Max(y.Negative));
```
